1. (a) Jika suatu filem sinematografi asal yang penayangannya disertai dengan

bunyi atau tidak disertai dengan bunyi (filem sinematografi bisu)

dikemukakan bagi maksud penapisan dan Lembaga, setelah membuat

penapisan—

(i) meluluskan filem itu untuk ditayangkan tanpa apa-apa pengubahan

sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam perenggan 10(1)(a) Akta;

(ii) meluluskan filem itu untuk ditayangkan dengan pengubahan

sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam perenggan 10(1)(b) Akta;

atau

(iii) enggan meluluskan penayangan filem itu sebagaimana yang

diperuntukkan dalam perenggan 10(1)(c) Akta.

(b) Jika suatu filem sinematografi yang dikemukakan bagi maksud penapisan

ialah pendua bagi filem yang dirujuk dalam subperenggan (a), tanpa mengira

sama ada Lembaga meluluskan filem itu dengan atau tanpa pengubahan

di bawah perenggan 10(1)(a) atau (b) Akta.

FILM CENSORSHIP ACT 2002

FILM CENSORSHIP (FEES) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 27(b) of the Film Censorship Act 2002

[Act 620], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Film Censorship (Fees)

(Amendment) Regulations 2014.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 July 2014.

Amendment of Schedule

2. The Film Censorship (Fees) Regulations 2011 [P.U. (A) 16/2011] are amended by

substituting for Schedule the following Schedule:

1. (a) Where an original cinematograph film of which the projection is

accompanied or not accompanied by sound (a silent cinematograph

film) is presented for the purpose of censorship and the Board, upon

censorship—

(i) approves the film for exhibition without any alteration as

provided for in paragraph 10(1)(a) of the Act;

(ii) approves the film for exhibition with alteration as provided

for in paragraph 10(1)(b) of the Act; or

(iii) refuses to approve the film for exhibition as provided for in

paragraph 10(1)(c) of the Act.

(b) Where a cinematograph film presented for the purpose of

censorship is a duplicate of a film referred to in subparagraph (a),

irrespective of whether the Board approves the film with or

without alteration under paragraph 10(1)(a) or (b) of the Act.
